text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلْحُجُرَٰتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ

words.gloss_range: emphatic annulling particle that makes the whole censure a governed, settled assertion
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) does more than open the sentence; it puts the whole report under emphatic assertion. The reader first meets certainty, then the relative description of the callers, and only after the behavior and location does the predicate land as a verdict. Its doubled particle form gives the opening a compressed force, while the repeated inna-alladhina frame across 49:3 and 49:4 makes praise and censure feel grammatically parallel.

topics.headline: emphatic governance of the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the callers' condition presented as a governed assertion, not as a loose observation.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the particle as governing the relative subject and the final predicate clause.

topics.headline: assertion opens before evidence and verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah displays the conduct and spatial breach before the asserted cognitive verdict arrives.
topics.reason: The governed frame begins at the first word and reaches the predicate after the relative action and location.

topics.headline: compressed onset and boundary parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the emphatic onset as formally tight and sees it repeat the prior ayah's assertion frame with an opposite judgment.
topics.reason: The particle form is the emphatic annulling particle, and boundary rows identify the repeated opening frame from 49:3 into 49:4.

words.gloss_range: definite plural relative pronoun that identifies the judged group through the following act of calling
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the people known by a relative clause rather than by a name. Their identity is built from what follows: they are the ones whose calling defines them in this sentence. The plural form gathers a group large enough to be subdivided later, and the same inna-alladhina opening from 49:3 is now turned from approved restraint to censured address.

topics.headline: identity routed through action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is defined by its conduct, not by lineage or a static label.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun introduces the clause that identifies the subject by the following verb.

topics.headline: governed plural subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a governed collective, not an isolated offender, which prepares the later majority qualification.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the relative pronoun the governed subject of the emphatic particle, while its form is masculine plural.

topics.headline: same opening carries opposite judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same opening mold that praised lowered voices in 49:3 now frames the opposite behavior.
topics.reason: The relative subject is built before the predicate, and the boundary rows mark the repeated frame across 49:3 and 49:4.

words.gloss_range: ongoing directed calling toward the singular addressee, with the message unstated and the spatial source supplied afterward
words.root_gloss_range: call, summons, and assembly-field pressure; local Form III selects directed vocal effort rather than a free dictionary range
words.prose: {{ar:يُنَادُونَكَ}} ({{tr:yunādūnaka}}) compresses many callers and one directly targeted addressee into a single verb, while leaving the content of the call unstated. The imperfect makes the behavior feel present or recurrent inside the relative clause, so the group is identified by intrusive address rather than by a quoted message. The root field of {{ar:ن د و}} ({{tr:n-d-w}}) gives the act public summons and assembly pressure, but the local Form III keeps that pressure narrowed to directed effort toward the addressee. That makes the voice feel projected across a boundary, especially when the following spatial phrase supplies the source, and the voice theme contrasts with the earlier restraint warning in 49:2 and the lowered voices of 49:3.

topics.headline: targeted calling without quoted content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees disrespect located in the directed act of calling itself, not in a quoted message.
topics.reason: The verb carries a 2ms object suffix and no quoted speech complement.

topics.headline: ongoing conduct defines the group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that calling is the group's defining profile within the relative clause.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb carries plural subject agreement resolved by the preceding relative pronoun.

topics.headline: public summons pressure narrowed to directed effort
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the call as a projected summons aimed into protected space, while local morphology keeps it from becoming a generic assembly scene.
topics.reason: The local surface is Form III with a direct object, so assembly-field rows survive as summons pressure rather than as a separate setting.

topics.headline: spatial adjunct maps the breach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can map the communication line: target suffix, source marker, and chamber-side phrase together show address crossing a barrier.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following source phrase an adjunct of the calling verb.

topics.headline: voice theme reverses restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the calling as the negative counterpart to the nearby voice-restraint material in 49:2 and 49:3.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect this imperfect plural calling with the voice warnings and restrained voices in 49:2 and 49:3.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the spatial source and separation point of the calling, not a partitive relation here
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) turns the calling into a sourced movement: the voice comes from a marked outside point. It governs the following locative and starts a nested chain that ends at the chambers, so the preposition is the hinge from action to boundary. Its short nasal shape also acts like an audible bridge into the locative phrase that carries its force. Its local attachment selects spatial origin and separation rather than a partitive sense, making the callers' location part of the censure rather than background scenery.

topics.headline: source governance chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the small preposition launch the whole spatial dependency that locates the call outside the protected space.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence shows the preposition governing the locative noun as the source complement of the calling verb.

topics.headline: origin and separation, not partitive sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands that the particle marks distance from the addressee's space rather than counting the callers among a group.
topics.reason: The following locative and verb attachment select source/separation here, while broader partitive uses are not active in this frame.

topics.headline: hinge from action to boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah pivot from the act of calling to the impropriety of the place from which it comes.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase follows the verb and localizes it as speech from separation.

topics.headline: audible link to the locative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the source marker as a short bridge into the locative phrase that carries its force.
topics.reason: The row's sound observation reinforces the same phrase-level source relation carried by the grammar.

words.gloss_range: behind or beyond as a chamber-bound locative, with concealed-side and overreach pressure but not an independent verbal act
words.root_gloss_range: concealment, hiddenness, and kindling/disclosure pressures; local noun form selects a stable locative relation
words.prose: {{ar:وَرَآءِ}} ({{tr:warāʾi}}) is both governed by the source preposition and governing the chamber noun, so the location is dependent yet controlling. Its construct form makes the behind-or-beyond relation belong to those chambers, not to vague space. The double force of behind and beyond lets physical placement become social overreach, while the {{ar:و ر ي}} ({{tr:w-r-y}}) root field adds concealed-side pressure: the callers speak from what should remain out of direct access. The form is still a locative noun, so kindling or disclosure images remain pressure rather than a separate local action. Its stretched-and-stopped sound makes distance and arrest audible inside the chamber-bound locative. The same concealment field is sharpened by the disappearance-behind-a-veil recurrence in 38:32 and by the barrier-reason pairing noted at 59:14.

topics.headline: construct far-side location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the behind-or-beyond relation anchored to the chambers rather than left as a vague direction.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the source preposition and the head of an idafa with the chamber noun.

topics.headline: behind and beyond become overreach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the callers as both physically behind the chambers and socially beyond proper access.
topics.reason: The local locative supports behindness, while the supplied semantic rows preserve beyondness as a valid pressure in the same chamber-bound phrase.

topics.headline: concealed-side root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses that the call comes from a concealed side of the boundary, while the noun form keeps that as spatial pressure rather than a new event.
topics.reason: The local surface is an abstract locative noun, so concealment and kindling branches color the location without replacing it.

topics.headline: barrier and concealment echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect this chamber-side behindness with concrete Quranic scenes of concealment and barriered reasoning at 38:32 and 59:14.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete recurrence links at 38:32 and 59:14; they function as echo pressure, not as control of the local parse.

topics.headline: locative form and arrested sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word as a stable chamber-bound location whose stretched sound is arrested at the boundary.
topics.reason: The noun instance is an abstract locative construct; the sound rows reinforce distance and stoppage without changing the lexical value.

words.gloss_range: definite plural chambers as protected enclosed rooms that anchor the spatial breach
words.root_gloss_range: enclosure, stone-like blocking, interdiction, and reason/restraint associations; local noun selects protected chambers
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحُجُرَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥujurāti}}) gives the behindness a concrete endpoint: known, multiple protected chambers rather than generic houses. The {{ar:ح ج ر}} ({{tr:ḥ-j-r}}) root field makes those rooms feel like enclosures that bar access, with stone, prohibition, and restraint pressure supporting the literal chamber sense. That root pressure becomes pointed because the ayah soon denies reasoning; the 89:5 use of the same root family for reason lets architecture and cognition mirror each other without replacing the local meaning. Variant vocalizations preserve the chamber plural while shifting its compactness, and the Banū Tamīm addition variant shows how a named historical group would narrow what the standard relative wording leaves open. The constricted sound texture and rare chamber plural reinforce the enclosed-room image without replacing the literal referent.

topics.headline: definite plural protected chambers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a recognized protected space made of multiple enclosed rooms, not a generic location.
topics.reason: The word is a definite genitive plural completing the locative construct phrase.

topics.headline: enclosure and restraint root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the chambers as spaces whose very lexical family marks blocking, interdiction, and restrained access.
topics.reason: The local sense remains chambers, while related root branches give legitimate boundary and interdiction pressure.

topics.headline: architecture echoes reason and restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the chamber root's reason/restraint association, especially at 89:5, prepares the final denial of reasoning.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect the chamber root with the reason sense at 89:5 and with the final cognition verb, while local grammar keeps the noun architectural.

topics.headline: variant vocalizations keep plural chambers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the chamber noun as a plural-morphology pressure point whose variants keep the same protected referent.
topics.reason: The variant rows affect vocalic shape and syllable weight but do not displace the local chamber plural.

topics.headline: named-group variant contrasts with open wording
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the standard wording leaves the behavior generalizable, while the Banū Tamīm addition would historicize the actors.
topics.reason: The addition variant is useful as contrast but does not govern the standard text's unnamed relative subject.

topics.headline: sound texture and rare chamber wording
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a constricted sound texture that supports the enclosed-room image while the rare plural carries unusual lexical weight.
topics.reason: The sound rows support the literal enclosure image, and the distribution row marks the chamber plural as load-bearing without changing its local sense.

words.gloss_range: partitive majority of the callers, giving a qualified scope of blame rather than total condemnation
words.root_gloss_range: abundance, increase, and rivalry pressure; local elative plus suffix selects the greater share of this group
words.prose: {{ar:أَكْثَرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:aktharuhum}}) begins the verdict with a qualified subject: most of the same callers, not all of them. The elative plus plural suffix measures the greater share from inside the group and leaves an implied minority outside the predicate. The same suffix shape also crosses the boundary from the prior ayah while shifting to the censured callers here. The {{ar:ك ث ر}} ({{tr:k-th-r}}) root field adds abundance and social pressure, but the local form keeps the payoff partitive rather than merely saying many. Positioned before the negated reasoning verb, the word makes the closing censure scoped and formulaic; the majority-unreason phrase echoes the same pattern at 5:103 and 29:63.

topics.headline: qualified majority, not totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the censure is restrained to the dominant share of the callers, leaving exceptions grammatically possible.
topics.reason: The elative with a 3mp suffix refers back to the callers and creates a partitive majority expression.

topics.headline: new subject inside the verdict clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final judgment begin by setting its scope before stating the denied faculty.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence supports the word as the subject of the final negated verbal predicate inside the predicate of the opening assertion.

topics.headline: abundance pressure narrowed to partitive scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels numerical dominance as social pressure among the callers, while the local word still functions as a scoped majority.
topics.reason: Increase and rivalry branches provide pressure, but the local elative-suffix construction selects majority within this group.

topics.headline: majority-unreason formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the local verdict as part of a recurring Quranic pattern where majority status does not guarantee discernment.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows identify formulaic parallels at 5:103 and 29:63 linking the majority word with the reasoning verb.

topics.headline: same suffix shape, reversed referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pronoun shape carry over from the prior ayah while its referent shifts to the censured callers.
topics.reason: The suffix resumes the callers in this ayah, while the boundary rows note the same pronoun shape across the ayah boundary.

words.gloss_range: descriptive negation that scopes over the imperfect reasoning verb and fixes the verdict's polarity
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) fixes the final clause as negative before the reasoning verb arrives. It is descriptive negation, not a prohibition, and with the imperfect it denies an ongoing or characteristic practice. Its scope is narrow: it negates the reasoning predicate, not the earlier facts of calling and location. As a separate particle, it creates a visible polarity boundary after the majority subject, and its open sound briefly foregrounds denial before the cognition verb. That helps the ayah close as a stable cognitive verdict rather than a one-time misunderstanding.

topics.headline: present descriptive negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a reported ongoing failure of reasoning, not a command or a completed past mistake.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as negation before an indicative imperfect, and attachment evidence scopes it over the predicate verb.

topics.headline: narrow predicate scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader preserves the calling and location as narrated facts while the reasoning faculty alone is denied.
topics.reason: The negator governs the final imperfect within the predicate clause rather than the preceding relative description.

topics.headline: polarity set before the final verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final verb arrive under already fixed negative polarity, making the close categorical.
topics.reason: The separate negator precedes the closing imperfect and fixes the clause's polarity before the predicate lands.

topics.headline: open sound before cognition verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a brief open pause that foregrounds denial before the cognition verb.
topics.reason: The sound row is locally tied to the separate negator's placement before the final verb.

words.gloss_range: negated imperfect reasoning/restraint verb with no explicit object, leaving the failure broadly open
words.root_gloss_range: binding, understanding, reasoning, and restraint; local Form I imperfect denies the basic faculty in ongoing practice
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْقِلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿqilūna}}) is the ayah's landing word: after action, source, and chambers, the verdict names the missing faculty. The imperfect plural routes the denied action back through the majority subject, and the absent object keeps the failure open across protocol, boundary, and self-restraint rather than one named topic. The {{ar:ع ق ل}} ({{tr:ʿ-q-l}}) root field makes reason feel like binding impulse into measured conduct; local Form I keeps that as the basic faculty itself, not a specialized reflexive act. The third-person form evaluates the callers instead of addressing them, while the closing frame links the opening assertion to negated cognition. Its echoes with the calling verb, the chamber-root reason field at 89:5, the barrier-reason link at 59:14, and the presumption warning in 49:1 make the final word diagnose unrestrained address rather than merely low intelligence.

topics.headline: habitual failure with no object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the failure left broadly open, covering conduct and protocol rather than one stated object of understanding.
topics.reason: The verb is an imperfect under negation with no overt object in the local frame.

topics.headline: reason as binding restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the denied reason as lack of inner binding and self-restraint, not merely lack of information.
topics.reason: Root-image rows support binding and restraint pressure, while the local Form I imperfect selects the basic reasoning faculty.

topics.headline: majority bears the collective predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the majority as the collective bearer of the denied action, while the callers remain evaluated in the third person.
topics.reason: The plural verb agrees with the majority subject and is third person rather than direct address.

topics.headline: closing verdict under assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences lack of reasoning as the ayah's final takeaway, framed by the opening assertion.
topics.reason: The verb closes the predicate content of the emphatic clause, completing the assertion-to-negation architecture.

topics.headline: voice, chamber, and reason echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the final cognition verb to the calling cadence, the chamber-root reason field, and concrete barrier-reason echoes at 59:14 and 89:5.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows identify same-ayah verbal echo, chamber-root reason overlap at 89:5, and a barrier-reason co-occurrence at 59:14.

topics.headline: voice, distance, and cognition diagnose one pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word diagnose a pattern of unrestrained address that also answers the presumption warning in 49:1.
topics.reason: The boundary and synthesis rows connect voice projection, distance, and denied reason, with a same-surah contrast to 49:1.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The raised call, the far side of the chambers, and the negated reasoning at words 3, 5-6, and 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: A voice crosses a protected enclosure while the material image of reason is restraint or tethering. Cognition is therefore enacted as stopping one's summons at a boundary, not merely possessing information.

activation_trace.role: Raised calling supplies the outward vocal pressure that reaches toward the addressee.
The far side or beyond locates the callers across a separating threshold.
Keeping back by enclosure makes the chamber boundary protective rather than merely architectural.
Tethering with a hobble materializes reason as self-binding before action.

changed_reading.before: Most of the callers simply fail to understand proper manners.
changed_reading.after: Their lack of reason is visible as a failure to tether a raised summons at a protected threshold.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural callers, the majority expression, and the negated reasoning at words 3, 7, and 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call can carry the image of a council or gathering, while abundance can become rivalry by number. The group amplifies its own demand until numerical presence substitutes for discernment.

activation_trace.role: The council or gathering image turns the plural callers into a socially organized voice.
Rivalry through greater number makes the majority a source of pressure, not just a count.
Understanding as restraint identifies the missing counterforce to crowd amplification.

changed_reading.before: Several individuals happen to call at once.
changed_reading.after: A gathered majority manufactures authority through collective volume, and that substitution of number for judgment is the failure of reason.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Calling, being behind, the chambers, and the failure of reason at words 3, 5-6, and 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling can make something appear or become known, while the far side covers and the chamber shelters. The summons attempts to reverse the enclosure's direction by pulling a protected person into public availability.

activation_trace.role: Appearing or making known like a call supplies the pressure toward public manifestation.
Covering and putting out of sight gives the far side a concealment function.
Sheltered custody makes the chambers a zone of protected presence.
Restraint from improper action is the unexercised check on forced disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Behind the chambers only reports where the callers stand.
changed_reading.after: The call tries to convert sheltered absence into public presence on the callers' terms, so the spatial breach is also a breach of availability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The call, the majority, and the negated reasoning at words 3, 7, and 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Outlying or intermittent utterances combine with much speech and claims until communication coils into a tangle. The verse can diagnose an irrational speech-system rather than only deficient minds.

activation_trace.role: Scattered sides and intermittent utterances supply fragmented calls from the margins.
Abundance attached to speech or claims turns fragments into cumulative verbal pressure.
The twisted bend or tangle renders the resulting communication pattern as internally snarled.

changed_reading.before: The verse assigns a mental deficit to a majority of callers.
changed_reading.after: Their many marginal utterances form a tangled collective signal whose very organization displays the missing reason.

context_deltas.mechanism: The callers are spatially behind yet pragmatically advance themselves: by initiating the summons they seize the encounter's timing and place their demand before the addressee's own movement.

activation_trace.role: Advancing forward or preceding supplies the prohibited temporal and procedural initiative.
The far side supplies the physical rear position that contrasts with procedural precedence.
Raised calling is the act by which the callers move their demand ahead.
Tethering supplies the absent restraint on taking precedence.

structural_cues: 49:1 prohibits advancing before God and the messenger, while 49:4 places the callers physically behind the chambers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibited precedence and a rearward location; I infer that a shouted summons lets the callers jump the addressee's timing. A live alternative is that the two spatial expressions are only adjacent etiquette instructions.

changed_reading.before: The callers are merely outsiders positioned behind rooms.
changed_reading.after: Although behind in space, they put themselves first in procedure by dictating when the addressee must appear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent voice sequence gives sound a vertical scale and a relational ceiling: raising exceeds a measure, lowering actively holds sound down, and that audible calibration exposes what is in the heart.

activation_trace.role: Raising a thing supplies the upward motion assigned to vocal excess.
Being above a measure or limit turns volume into a breached ceiling.
Holding and lowering by reduction supplies the controlled acoustic alternative.
A trial that reveals the heart makes outward volume diagnostic of inward formation.
Understanding as restraint links acoustic calibration to reason.

structural_cues: 49:2 forbids raising voices above the prophetic voice; 49:3 pairs lowered voices with hearts that have been tested.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies raising, an upper limit, lowering, and a heart-revealing test; I infer a causal diagnostic from vocal control to inward restraint. The live alternative is that volume is commanded etiquette without broader cognitive force.

changed_reading.before: The callers violate a general rule of politeness.
changed_reading.after: Their call audibly crosses a calibrated ceiling, revealing that inward restraint has not yet governed outward sound.

context_deltas.mechanism: Patience holds the caller outside until movement properly originates inside and passes outward. The chamber is therefore both a spatial enclosure and a temporal gate whose opening belongs to the sheltered person.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self from agitation supplies the waiting force at the threshold.
Passing to the outside fixes the proper direction of movement through the enclosure.
Being covered and out of sight supplies the protected interior state before emergence.
The enclosed place supplies the gate across which timing must be respected.

structural_cues: 49:5 states the unrealized alternative as waiting until the addressee comes out to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-holding and outward emergence; I infer that legitimate access lets motion originate with the person inside instead of letting sound reach inward. The alternative is a simple delay with no directional ownership.

changed_reading.before: The fault is calling from an improper location.
changed_reading.after: The fault is commandeering both direction and timing: voice reaches inward instead of waiting for presence to move outward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The report sequence inserts a verification interval between an incoming signal and consequential action. The focus call displays the opposite architecture: signal becomes public action before reason can restrain and clarify it.

activation_trace.role: An arriving, transmitted report supplies the incoming signal that requires processing.
Disclosing meaning by speech or sign supplies clarification before response.
Lightness of forbearance and disturbed temperament supplies the rash bypass of verification.
Regret over what has passed supplies the downstream cost of an unrestrained response.
Reason as restraint supplies the missing pause between impulse and public call.

structural_cues: 49:6 sequences report, verification, harmful action in ignorance, and later regret.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an input-check-action sequence; I extend that control pattern to the focus verse's outgoing call and infer a collapsed processing interval. The alternative is that report verification and vocal access are separate domains.

changed_reading.before: Not reasoning means not knowing a social rule.
changed_reading.after: Not reasoning means failing to preserve the interval in which an impulse or signal is checked before it becomes consequential public action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The many callers do more than seek attention: collective summons pressures the messenger to move according to their demand. The adjacent conditional exposes this as a reversal of obedience whose result would be hardship rather than right direction.

activation_trace.role: Submission and obedience supply the relational direction the callers attempt to reverse.
Outnumbering and rivalry make the many requested matters a pressure of quantity.
Severe hardship supplies the consequence of letting collective demand govern.
Hitting the right course in conduct supplies the contrasting direction of sound judgment.
The raised summons is the practical instrument for demanding compliance.
The focus majority anchors the pressure mechanism in the verse itself.

structural_cues: 49:7 places the messenger among the audience and says that obeying them in much of the matter would cause them hardship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a conditional reversal of obedience and harm from many demands; I infer that summoning the addressee is one embodied attempt to make him follow their schedule. A live alternative is that a request for appearance need not be a command.

changed_reading.before: The crowd wants the addressee's attention.
changed_reading.after: The crowd uses abundance and summons to invert guidance, trying to make the messenger responsive to its many demands.

context_deltas.mechanism: A latent generosity branch in the focus call meets a context that first locates favor and blessing as given, then rejects turning one's own submission into a burdening favor. The summons can thus carry an entitlement claim: response is demanded as repayment for what callers imagine they have conferred.

activation_trace.role: Beneficence and gift establish favor as something received rather than leverage produced by the callers.
Good condition and blessing reinforce the direction of benefit toward the recipients.
Burdening a recipient by rehearsing a favor supplies the debt-making social mechanism.
Generosity and liberal giving activate a gift register inside the focus verb's split inventory.
Abundance attached to claims supplies the callers' inflated account of what they are owed.

structural_cues: 49:8 names favor and blessing; 49:17 reverses the human claim of having conferred submission as a favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gift, blessing, favor-as-burden, and a generosity branch for the focus root; I infer that the call seeks access as repayment. The alternative is that the generosity branch is inactive in the verbal summons.

changed_reading.before: The callers loudly request an appearance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they call as self-styled benefactors collecting a social debt, turning claimed generosity into coercive access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plural chambers can become a spatial image of partitioned group life. A faction curls around itself and speaks across compartments, while repair works on the relation between sides and restores a binding of kinship.

activation_trace.role: A wrapped or clustered faction supplies the self-enclosed social unit.
Removing estrangement supplies the counter-movement to enclosure and hostile distance.
The connection standing between parties makes the intervening relation an object of repair.
A tie or fastening gives brotherhood a binding force across divided sides.
The enclosed places anchor the partition image in the plural chambers.
The council or gathering image lets the callers function as a factional voice.

structural_cues: 49:9 repeatedly repairs what lies between two fighting groups, and 49:10 recasts the parties as brothers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosed factions, repair of the between, and binding kinship; I map the plural rooms onto compartmentalized social speech. The alternative is that the chambers remain domestic spaces with no factional extension.

changed_reading.before: A crowd calls from several physical rooms or their rear side.
changed_reading.after: The call can also sound like a faction speaking from inside its own social enclosure rather than repairing the relation between divided sides.

context_deltas.mechanism: A public call can do more than attract attention: in a sequence about mockery, faulting, and names, it may impose a socially visible identity on someone whose chamber otherwise protects control over appearance.

activation_trace.role: Mockery and laughter at another supply the hostile social use of public address.
Faulting by a pointed remark supplies the injurious content a call may carry.

structural_cues: The reciprocal nickname and epithet constructions at 49:11 words 27-28 are used only as uncited structure because their roots appear under missing_branch_inventories.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mockery, faulting, naming, and an uncited nickname sequence; I infer that vocative publicity can fix an identity onto a sheltered person. The alternative is that the focus call contains no naming aggression at all.

changed_reading.before: Calling is a neutral summons made too loudly or impatiently.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, public calling can seize representational control by making the sheltered addressee socially present under the callers' framing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated contrast between much and some activates the precision of 'most of them.' The verse diagnoses a prevalent behavior without collapsing every caller into one essence, and rational reading must preserve the minority left outside the judgment.

activation_trace.role: Abundance and numerical increase supply the large but non-total quantity under scrutiny.
Partitioning a whole into portions forces distinctions within an apparently uniform group.
Doubt and supposition make overgeneralization itself an epistemic risk.
The focus abundance anchors the deliberately partial judgment in 'most.'
Discernment and restraint require the reader not to extend the predicate beyond its stated share.

structural_cues: 49:11 says one mocked group may be better than another; 49:12 distinguishes much suspicion from the portion that is sin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated group and quantity partitions; I infer that the focus majority is an ethically important limit on censure. The alternative is that 'most' is ordinary rhetoric with no instruction for the reader's own judgment.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns the callers as a single irrational class.
changed_reading.after: It makes a measured majority diagnosis, preserving exceptions and requiring the reader to practice the same restraint the callers lack.

context_deltas.mechanism: The chamber boundary becomes epistemic as well as spatial. Proper distance leaves the hidden person hidden; covert pursuit and speech about absence model what happens when lack of access is converted into intrusive knowledge or publicity.

activation_trace.role: Keeping apart and taking distance supply the proper posture toward a protected boundary.
Secretly tracking information supplies the epistemic form of boundary crossing.
Speaking of a person in absence supplies the conversion of hiddenness into public speech.
Covering and withdrawal from sight anchor hiddenness in the focus location.
Sheltered custody makes the rooms a privacy membrane rather than an obstacle to defeat.

structural_cues: 49:12 moves from uncertain judgment to covert investigation and then to speech concerning an absent person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distance, secret tracking, and speech about absence; I infer a shared privacy logic with the chambers. The live alternative is that direct summons differs categorically from spying and backbiting.

changed_reading.before: The callers make noise outside a building.
changed_reading.after: They refuse the epistemic discipline of privacy, treating another's hiddenness as a problem their public voice is entitled to overcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The callers' council and numerical pressure can be heard as a collective identity seeking privileged access. The peoples-and-tribes sequence redirects branching groups toward mutual recognition and relocates honor away from competitive group performance.

activation_trace.role: Branching and dispersal supply differentiated human group formation.

Rivalry by number anchors the possibility that group size is being used as status leverage.

structural_cues: 49:13 moves from differentiated peoples and tribes to mutual recognition, then denies group status the final measure of honor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branching groups, inward-facing collectives, recognition, and honor rivalry; I infer that the gathered callers wield identity as an access credential. The alternative is that no lineage or status claim is active in 49:4.

changed_reading.before: A numerically large crowd behaves discourteously.
changed_reading.after: A collective may be converting group identity and size into entitlement, using its assembled voice to demand privileged access rather than reciprocal recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The literal outside-inside arrangement of the chambers becomes an analogy for speech and inward formation. A voiced profession can remain outside while the disposition that should govern it has not entered the heart.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies verbal profession, entry, and heart; I map that explicit inside-outside sequence onto the focus chambers. The alternative is that the spatial analogy is rhetorically attractive but not causally active in 49:4.

changed_reading.after: Their loud exterior speech images a deeper mismatch: utterance has arrived at the boundary, but governing discernment has not entered the interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: The callers use vocal manifestation as if making something public establishes its truth or informs authority. The later knowledge sequence separates human announcement from knowledge that already encompasses hidden and visible domains.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a path supplies a non-coercive model of directional guidance.

changed_reading.after: In the split-root sonic outlier, they mistake booming force for guidance, replacing gentle direction with volume.

strongest_changes: Physical rear position became procedural precedence: the callers stand behind yet put their demand first.
Voice acquired a measurable ceiling, and crossing it became evidence that inward restraint had not formed.
Waiting made the chambers a temporal gate whose proper movement begins inside and proceeds outward.
The majority became both a mechanism of collective pressure and a precise non-totalizing limit on censure.
Later inside-outside, knowledge, and favor sequences kept distinct readings alive: exterior claim without inward formation, announcement mistaken for knowledge, and gift converted into leverage.
summary.what_was_special: Material branches made reason tactile as tether, enclosure, and held movement, while council, quantity, privacy, and gift branches exposed several coexisting social mechanisms. Non-dominant split mappings added contained oscillation and booming contrasts without displacing the ordinary raised-call reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The council, lineage, generosity, pastoral, and oscillation branches may be analogical activations rather than live senses of the focus verb.
The verification, faction, naming, and privacy models may extend adjacent discourse architecture more strongly than the focus syntax alone warrants.
The inside-heart analogy and announcement-versus-knowledge model are coherent but depend on reconstructed cross-ayah direction supplied by the reader.
The non-dominant n-w-d and h-d-d mappings should remain visibly form-distant outliers rather than entering unqualified prose.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A call that bypasses the assembly's boundary.** ن د و B001 ("gathering in a council") coexists with B002 (raised calling), while ح ج ر B001/B004 supplies enclosure and enclosed place. Calling from beyond the rooms is explicit; I infer that the callers demand access without entering the regulated social form of council. Their error is procedural as well as vocal.
2. **Reason is the boundary internalized.** ع ق ل B001 (understanding as restraint) and B002 (tethering with a hobble) answer ح ج ر B002 ("restraint of reason"). The packet repeats restraint in the final predicate and the architecture. I infer that a physical enclosure should have become inward impulse-control; because it did not, the boundary is shouted across. "They do not reason" reads as failure to tether demand.
3. **What is screened is not absent.** و ر ي B005 (covering and putting out of sight) and B006 (the far side: behind, ahead, or beyond) preserve two spatial readings of *warāʾ*. The rooms hide the addressee, but concealment does not cancel presence. I infer that the callers treat invisibility as unavailability and compensate by force. The ayah distinguishes screened presence from absence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 49:12's protected hidden side and prohibition on probing made the rooms a model for personal informational boundaries, not only architecture. 49:14's faith not yet entering hearts then supplied a second enclosed interior, sharpening the claim that screened presence must be approached without forced access.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The chambers materialize the restraint that the callers lack.** `ح ج ر:B004` is an enclosed place, but `ح ج ر:B001` also images prevention by enclosure and `ح ج ر:B002` reason as a barrier against improper action. The clause ends with `ع ق ل:B001`, understanding precisely as restraint from ignorance or disgraceful action. The packet supplies the architectural barrier and the cognitive barrier; I infer that crossing the former by projected voice reveals failure of the latter. The chambers thus become an enacted model of the self-boundary that reason should have maintained.

2. **Calling from concealment seeks access without submitting to presence.** `ن د و:B002` supplies the raised call and its carrying reach; `و ر ي:B006` places the caller on the other side of a barrier, while `و ر ي:B005` adds withdrawal from sight. This reverses 49:3, where genuine nearness (**عِندَ**) produces lowered voice, and it is corrected in 49:5 by waiting for an outward emergence. The packet gives hidden position, extended voice, presence, and waiting; I infer that the callers attempt to make vocal reach substitute for relationally governed access. The fault is therefore not distance alone but trying to control the encounter while remaining outside its proper terms.

3. **“Most of them” exposes numerical pressure as a counterfeit authority.** `ك ث ر:B001` supplies abundance, while `ك ث ر:B002` activates rivalry or overpowering through number and `ك ث ر:B003` includes much speech. The council-gathering sense of `ن د و:B001`, the warning in 49:7 that compliance with them in much of the matter would cause hardship, and the two mobilized factions in 49:9 give the crowd a social mechanism. The packet does not state that the callers coordinate; I infer exploratorily that repeated collective calling converts number and verbal volume into pressure. The verse then reads as a diagnosis of majoritarian insistence that lacks the restraint constitutive of understanding.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayat 49:14–18 turn the chamber boundary into an epistemic symbol: projecting a voice through an enclosure does not create governed access, just as speaking about a hidden heart does not certify it. `ح ج ر:B001`, `ح ج ر:B002`, and `غ ي ب:B001` together sharpen reason as acceptance of limits on access.

baseline.text: Şüphesiz sana odaların arkasından seslenenlerin çoğu akıllarını kullanmıyor.

findings.text: Odaların fiziksel sınırı, aklın uygunsuz dürtüyü içeride tutan sınırını somutlaştırır; sesi bu sınırın ötesine zorlamak içsel özdenetim eksikliğini açığa çıkarır.
Perde arkasından uzatılan çağrı, ilişkisel kurallara göre hazır bulunmanın yerine yalnızca sesin erişimini koyar; görünmezlik, zorla erişim hakkı doğurmaz.
“Çoğu” ifadesinin kalabalık ve çok söz yoluyla çoğunluk baskısını ima ettiği okuma mümkündür; ancak çağrıların örgütlü bir baskı olduğu ayetten gösterilemez.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A protected interior is approached across a boundary whose crossing must be authorized, patient, and inwardly completed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Architectural enclosure becomes a model for reason, piety, pardon, and the difference between an exterior declaration and an admitted interior state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Waiting Outside the Chamber
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Outsiders call across an enclosure; restraint preserves the boundary until the one inside emerges.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: enclosed chamber `quranic:root_000296:B004/m01`; preventing enclosure `quranic:root_000296:B001/m01`; the other side of a barrier `quranic:root_001642:B006/m01`; raised call `quranic:root_001486:B002/m01`; self-restraint `quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`; emergence from an interior `quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 49:4 has the chamber, calling, and "behind"; 49:5 has restraint and emergence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene is not merely loud speech near a dwelling. The callers remain on the wrong side of a real boundary, and patience is the operation that keeps them there until emergence is granted. Enclosure, distance, call, restraint, and exit therefore form one threshold scene in which correct relation depends on refusing to force access.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A protected interior is approached across a boundary whose crossing must be authorized, patient, and inwardly completed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Architectural enclosure becomes a model for reason, piety, pardon, and the difference between an exterior declaration and an admitted interior state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covering as Protection and Pardon
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A vulnerable interior is preserved by shielding, avoidance, and a cover that can also conceal fault.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: shielding from harm `quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`; placing oneself within protection `quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`; protective covering `quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`; covering a fault in pardon `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`; atonement that covers a wrong `quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`; moving aside from danger `quranic:root_000262:B003/m01`; reason as a restraining barrier `quranic:root_000296:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: protection occurs at 49:1, 3, 10, 12, and 13; pardon at 49:3, 5, and 14; covering at 49:7; avoidance at 49:12; the chamber root at 49:4.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Protection is assembled from several compatible operations: a barrier restrains approach, the self moves aside from exposure, and a cover prevents injury or covers an already committed fault. Pardon and atonement extend that cover from prevention to repair. The chamber boundary is thus reframed as an ethical technology protecting both what is within and the person who might otherwise trespass.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Right relation consists in taking a governed direction: not moving ahead of the guide, accepting restraint, and returning after deviation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guidance is embodied as procession, measured travel, bridle, tether, city, and road geometry, so obedience appears as coordinated motion rather than passive immobility.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Bridle, Tether, and Handover
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Forceful independent motion is brought into alignment through restraint, attachment, and voluntary handover.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: intellect that restrains ignorance `quranic:root_001036:B001/m01`; camel tether `quranic:root_001036:B002/m01`; held tongue `quranic:root_001036:B003/m01`; handover and surrender `quranic:root_000737:B012/m01`; submission under another's hand `quranic:root_001693:B006/m01`; bridle that restrains and corrects `quranic:root_000348:B006/m01`; tether or binding tie `quranic:root_000020:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: reason/tether occurs at 49:4; the hand root at 49:1; wisdom and restraint at 49:8; the brother/tie root at 49:10 and 12; surrender at 49:14 and 17.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: These senses materialize governed obedience without collapsing it into compulsion. Intellect, tongue, animal motion, and social relation are each held by an appropriate restraint. Bridle and tether check direction, while handover yields control, explaining how external surrender can be real alignment while remaining distinct from inward faith.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What enters or leaves the mouth can violate a protected relation and spread corruption through a social or bodily organism.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Backbiting is pressured by veterinary pathology, burial, shared bodily tissue, and a concealed spark that turns circulating talk into social fire.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Toxic Feeding Swells Within
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Appetite takes in harmful matter; concealed corruption develops internally as swelling near death.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: livestock swelling from toxic fodder `quranic:root_000289:B001/m01`; prepared food or prey `quranic:root_000043:B007/m01`; corrosion and bodily decay `quranic:root_000043:B006/m01`; appetite for meat `quranic:root_001348:B002/m01`; appetite pressed toward food `quranic:root_000268:B006/m01`; disease that eats the innards `quranic:root_001642:B001/m01`; internal swelling or fullness `quranic:root_001470:B006/m01`; hidden inward corruption `quranic:root_000464:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the swelling/invalidating root occurs at 49:2; the inward-disease root at 49:4; eating and flesh at 49:12; inward entry at 49:14; exertion/appetite at 49:15. Surface anchoring is unavailable for `quranic:root_001470:B006/m01` (`ن ب و`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This is a distinct consequence scene rather than another rendering of the corpse meal. Appetite receives harmful matter as food, but a disease eats the eater from within while hidden corruption swells toward collapse. The inversion makes socially appetitive speech look nourishing at intake and predatory after admission.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Value Made Visible in Gift, Work, and Cost
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Claims to worth become legible through accountable production, truthful enactment, transfer, and expenditure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel distinguishes spoken claims from manufactured ones, and received favor from the laboring hands and spent capacity by which commitment becomes visible.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Favor Converted into Social Leverage
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A giver recalls a benefit, burdens the recipient with it, and turns generosity into a claim of superior standing.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: burdening a recipient by reminding them of a gift `quranic:root_001449:B003/m02`; claiming superiority `quranic:root_001163:B004/m01`; outnumbering and boasting `quranic:root_001286:B002/m01`; competing in generosity `quranic:root_001294:B006/m01`; rivalry for name or standing `quranic:root_000745:B007/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the cited evidence roots occur at 49:4, 7, 8, 11, 12, 13, 16, 17, and 18.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This scene reverses the gift relation. What first moved toward another as benefit is pulled back as a debt and used to elevate the giver. The lexical split within the bestowal branch is decisive: the same act can give good or repeatedly impose its memory, which clarifies why claiming credit for surrender is itself a distortion of favor.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Benefit reaches a receptive body as moisture, restores capacity, and becomes visible as fertility, healing, or generosity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel models favor by its reviving effect in the recipient rather than by the giver's retained credit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rain Reaches Fertile Ground
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Dew and rain descend through the air, reach soft ground, and enable it to bear growth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dew `quranic:root_001486:B003/m01`; moisture or dew `quranic:root_000152:B001/m01`; rain falling between cloud and earth `quranic:root_000672:B005/m01`; fertile rain and earth `quranic:root_001294:B002/m01`; soft receptive ground `quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: dew occurs at 49:4; road/rain at 49:15; fertile earth and honor at 49:13; earth at 49:16 and 18. Surface anchoring is unavailable for `quranic:root_000152:B001/m01` (`ب ل ل`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene gives reception a material shape. Moisture must cross a gap and meet ground capable of taking it in; fertility is the resulting state, not a property the rain claims for itself. This usefully reframes guidance and mercy as arrivals whose truth is disclosed by renewed capacity.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Benefit reaches a receptive body as moisture, restores capacity, and becomes visible as fertility, healing, or generosity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel models favor by its reviving effect in the recipient rather than by the giver's retained credit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Dew Becomes Gift and Healing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Moisture revives what has dried, passes into generosity, and appears in the recipient as recovery and blessing.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: generosity `quranic:root_001486:B004/m01`; good, gift, or kinship figured as moisture `quranic:root_000152:B002/m01`; recovery or healing `quranic:root_000152:B003/m01`; mercy `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`; blessing `quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`; unowed gift or favor `quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the cited evidence roots occur at 49:4, 5, 8, 10, 12, and 14. Surface anchoring is unavailable for `quranic:root_000152:B002/m01` and `quranic:root_000152:B003/m01` (`ب ل ل`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The same lexical family turns wetness into benefit, restored health, and relational good. Mercy and blessing complete the operation: favor matters because it revives and reconnects. This directly resists the conversion of generosity into leverage, since moisture that is hoarded cannot perform the scene.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الأول النادي والندى المجلس يندو القوم حواليه وإذا تفرقوا فليس بندى (maqayis)؛ دار الندوة بمكة لأنهم كانوا يندون فيها أي يجتمعون (maqayis)؛ ناديته جالسته في الندى (maqayis)؛ الندى مجلس القوم ومتحدثهم وكذلك الندوة والنادي والمنتدى (sihah)؛ فإن تفرق القوم فليس بندي (sihah)؛ فليدع ناديه أي عشيرته وإنما هم أهل النادي (sihah)؛ ندوت أي حضرت الندي وانتديت مثله (sihah)؛ ندوت القوم جمعتهم في الندي (sihah)؛ النادي المجلس يندو إليه من حواليه ولا يسمى ناديا حتى يكون فيه أهله (tahdhib)؛ أناديك أشاورك وأجالسك من النادي (tahdhib)؛ يعبر عن المجالسة بالنداء حتى قيل للمجلس النادي والمنتدى والندي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, deve veya atın sudan yakın otlağa götürülüp kısa süre otlatılmasını ve yeniden suya döndürülmesini; buna bağlı yer ve ara öğün adlarını da açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sıradan otlatmayı değil, su ile yakın otlak arasında dönüşlü ve aşamalı hayvan yönetimini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıflandırma yalındır; tanım su, yakın otlak, kısa otlama ve suya dönüş aşamalarının tümünü korur.

concept_map.definition: Deve veya atı suladıktan sonra yakın otlağa götürüp bir süre otlatma ve yeniden suya döndürme; buna, bu döngünün yeri ile iki sulama arasındaki otlama öğünü de bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Hayvan suya getirilir, yakın otlağa çıkarılır ve kısa bir otlamadan sonra yeniden suya döndürülür.
Hareket tuzcul otlaktan taze otlağa geçip geri dönme biçiminde de gerçekleşebilir.
Döngünün gerçekleştiği sulama yeri ile iki sulama arasındaki otlama öğünü aynı dala bağlı adlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu anlatım, su ile yakın otlak arasındaki dönüşlü hayvan yönetimini verir; yer ve ara otlama öğünü bu sürecin bağlı adlarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: hayvanı su ile yakın otlak arasında döndürme
concept_gloss.applicability: Sulama, kısa süre otlatma ve yeniden suya getirme aşamalarının tamamı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Suya getirme, otlatma ve geri döndürme aşamalarını eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Süreç içindeki ara otlama veya hayvanın yediği öğün adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki sulama arasındaki bağlı otlama öğünü anlamını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: develerin su ile yakın otlak arasında gidip dönmesi
hayvanı sulayıp kısa süre otlattıktan sonra yeniden suya getirme
atın su, otlak ve dönüş döngüsünü yapması
hayvanın su ile otlak arasında döndürüldüğü yer

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, iki sulama arasındaki otlama öğününü de açıkça kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, belirli bir anlatımda atı terleyene kadar çalıştırmayı da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: hayvanı su ile otlak arasında döndürme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın çekirdeğinde hayvanı sudan yakın otlağa çıkarıp yeniden suya getirme döngüsü vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ana süreç ortaktır; odak dal ara öğünü kapsarken komşu dal belirli bir at çalıştırma uzantısına da sahiptir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; aynı döngüyü taşıyıp bağlı uzantılarda ayrılan en yakın komşu yayımlandı.
branches.branch_image_ar: تندية الإبل والخيل بين الماء والمرعى
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ندوة الإبل والتندية في الإبل والخيل، بأن ترد الماء ثم ترعى ساعة أو تنتقل من المشرب إلى المرعى القريب أو من الحمض إلى الخلة ثم تعود، ويدخل فيه موضع الشرب القريب والأكلة بين الشربتين.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو النادي بمعنى مجلس الناس، ولا الندى بمعنى المطر نفسه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: ندوة الإبل أن تندو من المشرب إلى المرعى القريب منه ثم تعود إلى الماء (maqayis)؛ وكذلك تندو من الحمض إلى الخلة وأندى إبله من هذا (maqayis)؛ ندت الإبل إذا رعت فيما بين النهل والعلل فهي نادية (sihah)؛ أنديتها أنا ونديتها تندية والموضع مندى (sihah)؛ الندوة بالضم موضع شرب الإبل (sihah)؛ التندية في الإبل والخيل أن يوردها الماء ثم يردها إلى المرعى ساعة ثم يعيدها (tahdhib)؛ وقد ندا الفرس يندو إذا فعل ذلك (tahdhib)؛ الندى الأكلة بين الشربتين (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ıslaklık ve nemi çekirdek olarak verir; yağmur, çiy, ıslanmış nesne ile nemli gün, gece ve yer kullanımları bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bitki ve yağ için kullanılan bağlı adlar bu dalın kendisi değil, ayrı sonuç veya aktarım dallarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel ıslaklık çekirdeğini korur ve yerin nemini bildiren kalıpla sınırlı kullanımı ayrıca gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeye ulaşan ıslaklık ve nem; yağmur, çiy, nesnenin ıslanması ile yerin, günün ya da gecenin nemli olması buna bağlı gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: Islaklık ve nem durumudur; yağmur ve çiy bu çekirdeğin örnek gerçekleşmeleridir.
Bir nesnenin ıslanması ve yer, gün veya gecenin nemli olması bu durumun gerçekleşmeleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt ıslaklık ve nem çekirdeğinde birleşir; yağmur, çiy, ıslanma ve nemli zaman ya da yer kullanımları bu çekirdeği gerçekleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: ıslaklık ve nem; yağmur ve çiy
concept_gloss.applicability: Maddenin ıslanmasıyla yer ve zamanın nemli oluşunu birlikte kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Islaklık, nem, yağmur ve çiy bağlantılarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin su veya çiy etkisiyle ıslak duruma gelmesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Nesnenin nem ve ıslaklık kazanması anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bitki ve yağ kullanımlarını ayrı dallara bırakır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bitki ve yağ adlarını da ıslaklıkla ilişkileri bakımından aynı kapsamda anar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yağmur ve çiyden gelen ıslaklık ile yerin ve nesnenin nemini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Islaklık çekirdeği aynıdır; komşu dal, bu kökten türetilen bitki ve yağ adlarını daha geniş bir ilişkisel çerçevede içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; aynı ıslaklık çekirdeğini daha geniş sonuçlarla birleştiren komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الندى بمعنى البلل والرطوبة والمطر والطل، وندى الشيء إذا ابتل، والأرض أو اليوم أو الليلة الندية.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو الندى بمعنى الجود، ولا الشحم أو النبت إلا من جهة أنهما يذكران فرعين ناشئين عن البلل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأصل الآخر الندى من البلل معروف (maqayis)؛ الندى المطر والبلل (sihah)؛ ندى الأرض نداوتها وبللها (sihah)؛ ندي الشيء إذا ابتل فهو ند (sihah)؛ ندى الماء فمنه المطر أصابه ندى من طل ويوم ندي وليلة ندية (tahdhib)؛ الندى ما أصابك من البلل (tahdhib)؛ أصل النداء من الندى أي الرطوبة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi otlak bitkisini ve ağacı adlandırır, ayrıca bu adlandırmayı yağmur nemiyle yetişen sonucun sebebinin adıyla anılmasına bağlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yağmurun veya nemin kendisini değil, onunla yetişen otlak bitkisini ve ağacı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bitki adı olan genel kullanımla nemle yetişmiş ağacı bildiren kalıplaşmış kullanımı ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Yağmurun ve nemin etkisiyle yetişen otlak bitkisi, ot veya ağaç; sonuç, onu yetiştiren ıslaklığın adıyla anılır.

facets.statement: Hayvanın yiyebileceği otlak bitkisi, ot veya ağaçtır.
Bitkinin adı, onu ortaya çıkaran yağmur ve nem sebebinden aktarılmıştır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt ot, otlak bitkisi ve ağacı kapsar; adlandırma, bitkinin yağmur neminden yetişmesiyle açıklanır.

concept_gloss.text: yağmur nemiyle yetişen otlak bitkisi
concept_gloss.applicability: Ot, otlak bitkisi ve bunlarla birlikte anılan ağaç kullanımını sebep ilişkisiyle kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Bitki, otlak ve yağmur neminden yetişme ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ağaç için kullanılan ve yetişme sebebini vurgulayan sınırlı kalıpta uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ağacın nemle yetişmiş olma niteliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yağmur nemiyle yetişen ot ve otlak bitkisi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bitki adını özellikle yağmur neminden yetişme sebebiyle ilişkilendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yeryüzünde hayvanların yediği bütün otlak ve yem bitkilerini genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: otlak ve hayvan yemi olan bitki
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da hayvanların otladığı ot ve yeryüzü bitkileri bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı yönü yağmur nemiyle yetişme ve sebepten sonuca ad aktarımıdır; komşu dal daha genel bir yem ve otlak sınıfıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel otlak bitkisi ile yağmur nemine bağlı adlandırma arasındaki sınır yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الندى بمعنى الكلأ أو النبت، والشجر المسمى ندى لكونه من الندى.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو المطر نفسه، ولا الشحم الذي يكون عن النبت.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الندى الكلأ (sihah)؛ تسف الند (sihah)؛ قيل للنبت ندى لأنه عن ندى المطر نبت (tahdhib)؛ يسمى الشجر ندى لكونه منه وذلك لتسمية المسبب باسم سببه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu adı doğrudan hayvan yağı için verir ve adlandırmayı, yağın nemle yetişen bitkiden oluşmasına bağlayan açıklamayı destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yağmur, ıslaklık veya bitkinin kendisi değil, bunlarla beslenme sonucu oluşan hayvan yağıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın hayvan yağı anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve ıslaklık ya da bitki dallarını doğrudan anlam saymaz.

concept_map.definition: Hayvan yağı; adın, hayvanın nemle yetişen bitkiyle beslenmesi sonucu oluşan yağa aktarılmış olduğu açıklanır.

facets.statement: Hayvan bedeninde bulunan yağdır.
Adlandırma, yağın nemle yetişen bitkiden beslenme sonucu oluşmasıyla açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım hayvan yağını verir; nemli bitkiden beslenme, adın bu anlama aktarılmasının gerekçesidir.

concept_gloss.text: hayvan yağı
concept_gloss.applicability: Hayvan yağı çekirdeğini karşılar; nemli bitkiyle beslenme bağı adlandırmanın gerekçesidir.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan yağı çekirdeğini korur ve adlandırma gerekçesini uygulama açıklamasında belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal hayvan yağını genel olarak ve bitkisel beslenme bağıyla adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnız koyunun karın zarındaki belirli bir yağ dokusunu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da hayvan bedenindeki yenebilir yağ dokusunu konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel hayvan yağıdır; komşu dal ise belirli bir hayvanın belirli anatomik bölgesindeki yağla sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel hayvan yağı ile belirli anatomik yağ arasındaki en açık sınır seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الندى بمعنى الشحم، وخاصة حين يفسر بأنه يكون عن ندى النبت.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو المطر أو البلل نفسه، ولا الجود.
branches.source_phrase_ar: ربما عبروا عن الشحم بالندى (maqayis)؛ الندى الشحم (sihah)؛ فالندى الأول المطر والثاني الشحم (sihah)؛ قيل للشحم ندى لأنه عن ندى النبت يكون (tahdhib)؛ أراد بالندى الثاني الشحم وبالأول الغيث (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi eli açıklık, bol iyilik, verme ve arkadaşlarına karşı cömert davranma kullanımlarını tek bir cömertlik çekirdeğinde birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal fiziksel nemi değil, iyilik ve malı isteyerek ve bolca verme niteliğini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel cömertlik anlamını korur; el, arkadaş çevresi ve birinden pay alma kalıplarını ayrıca sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: İyilik, mal veya yarar sağlamada eli açık olma ve çevresindekilere bolca verme; belirli kalıplarda bu cömertliğin derecesi ya da birinden pay elde etme anlatılır.

facets.statement: İyilik ve mal vermede eli açık, cömert ve bol verici olma niteliğidir.
Karşılaştırma, arkadaşlarına cömert davranma ve birinden cömertlik payı elde etme kalıpları bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım cömertlik, bol iyilik ve verme üzerinde birleşir; el ve arkadaş çevresi kalıpları bu niteliğin kişiler arası gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.text: iyilik ve vermede eli açıklık
concept_gloss.applicability: Cömert kişilik niteliğini ve başkalarına bolca verme davranışını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: İyilik, cömertlik, eli açıklık ve bol verme unsurlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Cömertliğin özellikle kişinin arkadaş çevresine yöneldiği kalıplaşmış bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çevresindekilere yönelen cömert davranışı korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ondan hiçbir cömertlik payı elde etmedim

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, eli açıklığı ve arkadaş çevresine bol verme kalıplarını özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal malın yanında bilgiyi verme ve daha geniş özne türlerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da mal veya yarar sunmada cömertlik ve eli açıklık vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdek büyük ölçüde ortaktır; odak dal belirli el ve arkadaşlık kalıplarına bağlıyken komşu dal verme nesnesi ve özne bakımından daha geniştir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel cömertlik ile bu dalın el ve arkadaş çevresi kalıplarını karşılaştıran komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الندى بمعنى الجود والعطاء والمعروف والخير، وندي الكف، وأندى الرجل أو تندى إذا تسخى أو كثر عطاؤه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو البلل الحسي، ولا الإصابة بالمكروه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: هو أندى من فلان أي أكثر خيرا منه (maqayis)؛ وهو يتندى على أصحابه أي يتسخى (maqayis)؛ الندى الجود (sihah)؛ فلان ندي الكف إذا كان سخيا (sihah)؛ فلان يتندى على أصحابه أي يتسخى (sihah)؛ الندوة السخاء (tahdhib)؛ ندى الخير هو المعروف (tahdhib)؛ أندى الرجل إذا كثر نداه على إخوانه وكذلك انتدى وتندى (tahdhib)؛ يعبر عن السخاء بالندى (mufradat)؛ فلان أندى كفا من فلان وهو يتندى على أصحابه أي يتسخى (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi istenmeyen veya kötü bir şeye uğrama ve bulaşma ile utandıran söz veya davranışları aynı olumsuz etkilenme alanında toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kötülüğün soyut varlığından çok, kişiye ulaşması, ona bulaşması veya onu utandırmasıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım olumsuz etkilenme çekirdeğini, kötülüğe bulaşma ve utandırıcı sözler için kullanılan kalıplardan ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin istemediği, kötü veya yasak bir şeye uğraması ya da bulaşması; ayrıca bilinen ve sahibini utandıran söz veya davranışlar bu alana girer.

facets.statement: Kişiye istemediği veya kötü bir şeyin ulaşması ve onu olumsuz etkilemesidir.
Yasak kana bulaşma gibi ağır bir kötülüğe karışma kullanımı vardır.
Sahibini utandıran ve bilinen sözler veya davranışlar için çoğul bir ad olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt istenmeyen şeye uğrama, kötülüğe bulaşma ve utandırıcı söz ya da davranışlar arasında olumsuz etkilenme bağı kurar.

concept_gloss.text: kötü bir şeye uğrama veya bulaşma ve utandırıcı şeyler
concept_gloss.applicability: İstenmeyen etkinin kişiye ulaşmasını, kötülüğe bulaşmayı ve utandırıcı şeyleri birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Uğrama, bulaşma, kötülük ve utandırıcılık unsurlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişiyi toplum önünde utandıran bilinen söz veya davranışların çoğul adında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bilinen ve sahibini utandıran söz veya davranış anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kötü etkinin kişiye ulaşmasını ve utandırıcı sözlerin adlandırılmasını özellikle kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kötülük, suç, zarar, borç ve yergiyi daha geniş bir kirlenme alanında toplar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişinin kötü veya kınanabilir bir şeyle lekelenmesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal uğrama ve utandırıcı görünür sonuç üzerinde durur; komşu dal ise kötülük, suç ve zararın daha geniş türlerini kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; olumsuz etkilenme ile geniş kötülük lekesi arasındaki en yararlı sınır yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما نديت بشيء تكرهه أو بشر، وما نديت كفي، ويتند من الدم الحرام، والمنديات أو منديات الكلم بمعنى المخزيات.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو الندى بمعنى العطاء المحمود، ولا مجرد البلل الحسي.
branches.source_phrase_ar: ما نديت كفي لفلان بشيء يكرهه (maqayis)؛ المنديات المخزيات ويقال ما نديت بشيء تكرهه (sihah)؛ ما نديت كفي بشر وما نديت بشيء تكرهه (tahdhib)؛ من لقي الله ولم يتند من الدم الحرام بشيء (tahdhib)؛ منديات الكلم المخزيات التي تعرف (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız belirli bir kalıpta, dişi devenin soy bakımından seçkin develere çekmesini ve onların özelliklerini göstermesini anlatır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel soy veya soyluluk adı değildir; yalnız dişi devenin seçkin bir deve soyuna çekmesini bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çağırmayı, bağırarak ses yöneltmeyi, sesin yükselip belirginleşmesini ve uzağa erişmesini birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi bu eylem ile sesin menzili arasındaki bağı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek işitme değil, ses çıkarıp birine yöneltme ve sesin duyulur biçimde yükselmesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çağırma ve yükseltilmiş ses çekirdeğini kapsar; ibadete çağrı ile ses menzili karşılaştırmaları yalnız tanıklanmış yapılarda geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Birine ulaşmak veya onu çağırmak için sesi yükseltip belirgin biçimde yöneltmeyi anlatır. Sesin uzağa yayılması ve eriştiği mesafe de bu alana bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Birine yönelik yüksek, açık ve duyulur bir ses çıkarma ya da çağırma eylemidir.
Çıkarılan sesin uzağa yayılması ve başka bir sesten daha uzak bir menzile erişmesi de anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yüksek sesle çağırma ve seslenme çekirdeğinde birleşir; ayrıca sesin belirginliği, yükselmesi ve uzak mesafeye erişmesi aynı anlam alanına bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çağırma eylemi ile yükseltilmiş sesin menzilini birlikte temsil eden tam dal karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Yöneltilmiş çağrıyı, sesin yükselmesini ve uzağa yayılmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka bir kişiye yüksek ve açık bir ses yönelttiği bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Birine yönelik çağrı ve ses çıkarma eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sesin uzaklığa erişen menzilini ve menzil karşılaştırmasını belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sesin ne kadar uzağa yayıldığını anlatan yapılarda açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin yayılma mesafesini ve uzak erişimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir kişiyi çağırma eylemini tek başına anlatmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sesin uzak menzilini ve sesler arasındaki erişim karşılaştırmasını ayrıca kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da birine yöneltilen yüksek ve belirgin çağrı sesini çekirdek alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çağırma çekirdeği örtüşür; odak dalın sesin uzak erişimini bağımsız bir uzantı olarak taşıması sınırı biraz genişletir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tek bir çağrıyı ve sesin yükselip uzağa erişmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çağrının yeniden yapılmasını veya tekrarlanmasını kurucu koşul sayar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da duyurmak veya çağırmak amacıyla ses yükseltme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal için yineleme gerekmez; komşu dalda çağrının tekrarı veya geri dönüşü belirleyici özelliktir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Konuşanın ses çıkarıp çağrıyı yöneltmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dinleyenin sesi kulakla algılamasını ve ona dikkat vermesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Sesli iletişimin aynı olayında çağrı üretimi ile ses algısı karşı karşıya gelir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gönderici ve ses üretimi yönündedir; komşu dal alıcı ve işitsel algı yönündedir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; çağrı çekirdeğine en yakın dal, yineleme koşullu çağrı ve alıcı yönündeki işitme yayımlandı. Yalnız yüksek ses türlerini yineleyen veya başka kök anlamlarına kayan adaylar elendi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ıslaklık, nem ve yağmuru açıkça aynı çekirdekte toplar; ağacın bu nem bağıyla adlandırılmasını da ekler. Dal yardımındaki hayvansal yağ örneği ise yalnız ayrı sözbirim tanıklığında bulunduğundan dal çekirdeğine alınmamalı, yalnız kendi sözbirim karşılığında korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal fiziksel nem, ıslaklık ve yağmurla sınırlıdır; cömertlik mecazı ile ayrı hayvansal yağ adı çekirdeği genişletmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım fiziksel nem ve ıslaklık çekirdeğini verir; toprağın, nesnenin ve ağacın nemli oluşu ile hayvansal yağ adı yalnız tanıklanmış sözbirimlerde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Su, çiğ veya yağmurdan doğan nem ve ıslaklığı, ayrıca bu ıslaklığı taşıyan doğal yüzeyi anlatır. Ağaç da nemle ilişkisi üzerinden bu adla anılabilir.

facets.statement: Yağmur, çiğ veya başka su temasıyla oluşan fiziksel nem ve ıslaklıktır.
Nem taşıyan ağaç, nemle kurulan ilişki nedeniyle aynı adla anılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar nem, ıslaklık ve yağmuru ortak çekirdek sayar; toprağın ıslaklığı ile ağacın nem üzerinden adlandırılması bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

concept_gloss.text: çiğ, yağmur ve bunların oluşturduğu ıslaklık

error_profile.preserves: Çiği, yağmuru ve suyun bıraktığı fiziksel nemi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Toprak, bitki veya nesne üzerindeki fiziksel nemin öne çıktığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir yüzeyde bulunan fiziksel ıslaklığı korur.
error_profile.loses: Yağmur ve çiğin ayrıca adlandırıldığı kapsamı tek başına açık etmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ağacın nemle ilişkisi üzerinden aynı adla anıldığı kullanım için açıklayıcıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Ağacın nem taşımasına dayanan adlandırmayı açıkça korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal azlık ve yüzeysel ıslatma koşuluna bağlıdır; odak dalda böyle bir miktar koşulu yoktur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البلل والرطوبة والمطر والطل ونداوة الأرض والشجر، وما سمته المصادر ندى الشحم أو الكلأ من جهة البلل والنبات.
